hypothesis: On three fixed eligible synthetic stochastic binary summaries, all interval/normalization/independent finite-channel checks pass, and at least one of the two biased core cases has a combined production noise-time certificate at least 10 percent below the STRONGEST old certificate, including actual Chen hybrid, same older full-soft curve, and the applicable Kramer-Saglam convex-mixture extension. Balanced control receives no gain credit. A gain only against Chen hybrid does not meet the prediction.

input.exposure: Both manuscripts and selected originals were read before registration. Algebraic near-boundary new/Chen ratio and an applicable older mixture bound are known; no finite fixture MI, root, integral, time comparison or output has been computed. Not blind discovery. Explicitly synthetic aggregate-budget stress cases, no real workload representation claim.
input.initial_information: I0=H(m)-average_x H(g(x)); computed from full actual table, not independently chosen infeasible aggregates.
input.distribution: Uniform independent fair cube input; independently flip each coordinate with p=(1-exp(-tau))/2; stochastic bit U has P(U=+1|x)=(1+g(x))/2; binary output mean sign convention.

method.functions: L=ln2; H(r)=-((1+r)/2)ln((1+r)/2)-((1-r)/2)ln((1-r)/2); psi=L-H; F(psi(r))=r*atanh(r). Units nats, tau=-lnrho.
method.old_hybrid: h=H(m)-I. Cm=max(F(L-h)-abs(m)*atanh(s),F(I)), where abs(m)*H(s)=h*s; m=0 uses F(I). Source old bits/mean/time converted explicitly in WP047.
method.new_hybrid: alpha=1-m^2; Bm=2I+alpha*(F(L-h/alpha)-2*(L-h/alpha)), with zero-extension S below0; new=max(Bm,F(I)); combine=max(Cm,new). Check independent algebra Bm=2*(H(m)-alpha*L)+alpha*F(L-h/alpha) on these positive-domain fixtures.
method.integrated_times: Integrate dh/profile from initial conditional entropy h0 to hgoal; old Cm and combined each get outward lower/upper integrals. Upper endpoint is the sufficient chosen noise time; never call a quadrature midpoint a certificate.
method.strong_older_finite_curve: K_m(rho)=c*rho^2+alpha*psi(rho), c=H(m)-alpha*L. For biased fixture with N points, g is exact convex mixture of the N Boolean fields f_j with only vertex j negative: weight0=1-(N-1)*a/2, others=a/2. Each has same mean m. MI is convex in channel g with fixed input and output marginal, hence original Boolean Kramer bound also bounds this particular soft mixture. Balanced g=(1-a/2)x1+(a/2)(-x1), same mean0. Verify exact weights, mean and reconstruction. This is an explicitly justified old-method extension, not assumed arbitrary soft fixed-I0 theorem. No new-math credit.
method.old_soft_curve: Older same full-soft curve gives rho=psi_inverse(Istar)/psi_inverse(I0); time=ln(psi_inverse(I0)/psi_inverse(Istar)). Compare this too.
method.best_old: Time certificate is minimum of old hybrid integral, older full-soft time and applicable old Kramer root time. Compare interval minima; new versus a deliberately weaker old branch is insufficient.

judge.interval_arithmetic: Python stdlib Decimal, primary70 and verification100 significant digits. Each +,-,*,/ uses directed ROUND_FLOOR/CEILING. Decimal ln/exp correctly-rounded result enclosed with next_minus/next_plus; no reliance on round-nearest sums. Explicit H(+-1)=0. Interval inversion of decreasing H and mH(s)-hs uses72 bisections; ambiguous sign retains the current containing bracket and is reported if too wide. Bounds conditional on documented Decimal elementary-function guarantees, not a formal proof of the runtime.
judge.quadrature: Fixed64 cells with quartic grading h_j=h0+(hgoal-h0)*(j/64)^4. Endpoint and exact width intervals retain h0 uncertainty. Evaluate monotone inverse-H/root ranges, then full interval expressions over each cell; sum width/profile bounds. No adaptive refinement or post-output grid changes. Independent IEEE math implementation uses1024 quartic midpoint cells and separate scalar root bisections, and must fall inside primary integral intervals. It is a consistency check, not a certificate.
judge.precision: Run full primary protocol at70 and100 digits with same72 bisections/64 cells. Corresponding bounds must overlap; fixed-time direct/Walsh MI discrepancy upper bound<=1e-45. Report arithmetic enclosure widths separately from quadrature/root widths. No precision/grid tuning after outputs.
judge.finite_channel: At each chosen certificate time UPPER endpoint, calculate MI by explicit summation of joint P(U=u,Y=y) over every x,y,u using independent BSC transition products, and separately by exact rational Walsh coefficients with rho^degree and H(m)-average H(T_rho g). Cross-check intervals and normalization. Both organizations see the same frozen input table but do not share the channel computation.
judge.oracle: Use Walsh organization to bracket actual finite-table target-crossing tau in [0,1] with72 bisections; require endpoints straddle target and recheck endpoints by explicit joint probability. Report certificate/oracle gaps and operation counts. Full truth table oracle uses richer information than aggregate m,I0, so no runtime/same-input superiority claim.
judge.control: Exact rational means, strict interior field, stochastic joint mass1, and convex mixture reconstruction. Balanced old/new production intervals must overlap, with no incremental credit; analytical full-soft root time must lie in its old/combined integral enclosures. For every biased/core and control chosen certificate upper time, finite MI upper must be<=Istar lower+1e-40; otherwise structural/precision failure, not theorem refutation.
judge.decision: Resolved win iff combined_time_upper<=0.9*best_old_time_lower>0 in at least one biased case; uncertain inequalities count unresolved not success. Also report combined versus Chen-only, old-Kramer wins, and actual table optimum gaps.

failure: Any mixture/eligibility/mass/interval/independent arithmetic/control/resource failure or absence of a resolved core win. Preserve unfavorable/unresolved results. No formal mathematical rejection without humans. Do not alter cases, a, hgoal, thresholds, root bits, grids or baseline set after outputs.
metrics: Old hybrid/new combined/full-soft/Kramer time intervals and best-old selection
Independent float midpoint comparisons and70/100digit overlap
Actual direct joint/Walsh MI at certificate times and actual crossing endpoints
All-n assumptions, stronger-oracle input/cost gap and pass/fail reasons
Elapsed seconds and peak traced Python allocation
limits: Finite aggregate-budget application audit on three deliberately near-deterministic synthetic eligible inputs. No evidence of all-dimensional theorem correctness, real hardware, DP, downstream accuracy, compression, all soft-mixture extremes or universal improved algorithm. Source selected formal scope B only/full chain unknown, arithmetic verification scripts/Lean/human/second provider absent. Old Kramer may already suffice; this is explicitly a falsifiable comparison, not a promised positive effect.
